goals.title: Ship equipment checkout desk
goals.body: Build an equipment checkout desk from vague stakeholder requirements. Staff check assets in/out; requesters reserve items; admins manage inventory. Support asset catalog, checkout/return lifecycle, roles (requester, desk staff, admin), REST API, desk admin UI, public availability page, and audit log. Stack is agent choice.

tasks.title: Design architecture and data model
tasks.body: Choose stack. Design schema: assets, users/roles, checkout records, availability, audit events. Define REST API. Produce SPEC.md and PLANNING-MATRIX.md before implementation.

tasks.title: Implement REST API and auth
tasks.body: Backend: login/session, asset CRUD, checkout/return, role-based access. Tests for all routes.

tasks.title: Implement desk admin UI
tasks.body: Browser UI for desk staff and admins: asset list, checkout/return flows, filters, audit visible.

tasks.title: Implement public availability page
tasks.body: Read-only page showing which assets are available now. No visitor login.

tasks.title: End-to-end verification
tasks.body: Full test suite. Manual verify checkout/return, roles, public page, audit. Document VERIFY.md.

assumptions.title: Public page is read-only
assumptions.body: Visitors see availability only — no writes.
